| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| Room Light | The ring itself — turn it on or off, set colour and brightness like any light. |
| Night Mode | Switches the ring to a low, warm night look. Turn it on yourself, or let it activate automatically. |
| Night Mode Behaviour | When night mode turns on by itself: manually only, when the room is dark, or when the room is dark and occupied. |
| Status Indicator | Whether the ring briefly shows device status events as coloured overlays. |
| Darkness Threshold | How dark the room must be before automatic night mode considers it night. |
| Identify Device | Flashes the ring so you can tell which device you are looking at. |
